summary: Relay Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 22,916,667 shares of common stock at $12.00 per share, raising approximately $258.5 million in net proceeds. The offering is a standard shelf takedown under an existing S-3ASR registration statement, with Jefferies, TD Cowen, Goldman Sachs, Guggenheim Securities, and Raymond James as underwriters. The last sale price before pricing was $12.20. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. This is a routine equity capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No special-situations dynamics apply; the filing represents ordinary course financing.
